step.prompt: Single boot footstep on gritty cave stone, crunch of loose grit, close-mic, dry

step_wet.prompt: Single boot footstep splashing into shallow cave water, small wet slap, close-mic

room_enter.prompt: Short low whoosh of stale cave air shifting, faint distant metallic groan

exit_blocked.prompt: Heavy corroded metal door rattling against a locked bolt, dull clank, refusal

unlock.prompt: Old mechanical lock releasing, key turning, heavy bolt sliding back, servo whine and hiss of air

key_pickup.prompt: Single small metal key picked up off stone, one short bright clink, close-mic, dry

torch_pickup.prompt: Oil torch catching flame, quick whoomp ignition then crackle

torch_out.prompt: Burning torch extinguished, single clean sharp steamy hiss fading out, quiet, close-mic, no other sounds

mob_alert.prompt: Short guttural creature snarl with a sharp burst of radio static

hazard_tick.prompt: Sharp sizzle of skin touching caustic sludge, short painful hiss

interact_start.prompt: Hands rummaging through scrap metal and debris, short clatter

interact_loot.prompt: Old metal lockbox creaking open followed by a bright rising two-note relay chime

interact_hazard.prompt: Hidden trap springing, loud sharp metal snap followed by a short burst of hissing gas

interact_secret.prompt: Hidden stone panel grinding open, deep rumble, low resonant electronic hum swelling

interact_flavor.prompt: Soft rustle of old dust and pebbles trickling, quiet, close-mic

puzzle_ping.prompt: Old terminal attention beep, two short square-wave tones through a small speaker

gold.prompt: Handful of small metal scrap chits clinking together, bright, short

level_up.prompt: Rising electronic power-up chime on an old relay machine, warm hum swelling to a bright tone

amb_starter.prompt: Continuous dark cave ambience, slow water drips, distant low wind through tunnels, faint electrical hum

amb_fungal.prompt: Continuous damp cavern ambience, soft wet organic squelches, spores popping, slow drips, low drone

amb_crystal.prompt: Continuous cave ambience with faint ringing crystal resonance, glassy shimmering tones, soft air movement

amb_flooded.prompt: Continuous flooded tunnel ambience, lapping water, echoing drips, gurgling pipes, distant rush

amb_volcanic.prompt: Continuous volcanic cavern ambience, deep rumbling magma, bubbling lava, hissing steam vents

amb_bone.prompt: Continuous ossuary cave ambience, dry hollow wind, faint rattling bones, distant creaking

combat_start.prompt: Short tense combat stinger for a retro dungeon crawler game, sudden low brass hit and pounding drum, dark and ominous

melee_hit.prompt: Heavy scrap-metal weapon striking flesh and armor, meaty thud with metallic clank

melee_crit.prompt: Brutal heavy impact, bone crunch and metal crash, deep punchy transient

melee_miss.prompt: Fast heavy weapon swinging through air, whoosh, no impact

gun_shot.prompt: Crude junk-built scrap gun firing, loud cracking blast with rattling loose metal parts

gun_miss.prompt: Bullet whizzing past very close, fast sharp supersonic whiz

reload.prompt: Reloading a crude scrap-metal gun, clunky magazine slide, lever cock, loose metal rattle

dry_click.prompt: Empty gun dry-firing, single hollow metallic click

defend.prompt: Deep armoured bracing thud with a heavy metal shield slam and a short low power hum, close-mic

mob_hit.prompt: Creature claw strike hitting armor, one short heavy impact thud with a metal scrape

player_down.prompt: Armored body collapsing onto a stone floor, one heavy thud and a clatter of gear

mob_death.prompt: Mutant creature death gurgle and heavy wet collapse onto stone

heal.prompt: Short gentle healing stinger for a video game, soft rising bells over a warm synth pad, hopeful

ability_generic.prompt: Single bright sustained synth chord swelling in then fading out, short uplifting video game ability cue, instrumental

flee.prompt: Person sprinting away fast on gravel, rapid running footsteps receding into the distance

qte_prompt.prompt: Short tense rising electronic tick sweep, old targeting computer

qte_success.prompt: Crisp satisfying electronic lock-on confirm tone, bright relay snap

qte_fail.prompt: Low descending buzzer error tone on an old terminal, short

victory.prompt: Short triumphant victory fanfare stinger for a retro dungeon crawler game, brass and analog synth, bright resolving chord

wipe.prompt: Short somber defeat stinger for a dungeon crawler game, slow descending minor chord on low strings and dark synth, final

crack.prompt: Sharp bone-snapping crack with a bright metallic snap, punchy

boom.prompt: Deep concussive impact boom with a rumbling low tail, cave echo

shimmer.prompt: Shimmering rising electronic tone with sparkling static, energy charge

ui_click.prompt: Single crisp loud mechanical switch click, sharp transient, close-mic, dry

ui_tick.prompt: Very short crisp electronic tick like a relay contact closing, close-mic, dry

ui_power.prompt: Old CRT monitor switching on, sharp electrical thunk then a quick rising high whine, crisp and loud

ui_open.prompt: Metal cabinet panel sliding open with a servo whirr and click

ui_close.prompt: Metal cabinet panel sliding shut, soft thunk and latch click

shop_buy.prompt: Old mechanical cash register ding with coins dropping into a tray

shop_sell.prompt: Scrap items dropped onto a metal counter, then chits clinking into a hand

shop_reroll.prompt: Mechanical slot drum spinning and clattering to a stop, relay click

stash_move.prompt: Heavy item placed into a metal locker, clunk and short rattle

equip.prompt: Armor strap buckling and metal gear clicking into place, leather creak

portal_ready.prompt: Old machine arming, rising hum and heavy switch click

portal_enter.prompt: Deep humming energy gate activating, rising whoosh into a warping electrical roar
